static_traits.name: An Cheng
static_traits.family_status: 与配偶共同生活，有两个Female儿；因对烹饪的Self-doubt导致Tense family relationships
static_traits.social_status: 有几位要好的朋友，但尚not yet与他们讨论Self-doubt的感受
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness史；既往not yet接受心理治疗；此前not yet出现类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、语气偏消极、现场紧张与not安、合作度尚可但对改变缺乏信心、倾向Self-denial与回避与他人讨论感受

basic_info.main_problem: 我相信自己永远not会成为一名伟大的Chef，尽管我热爱烹饪，这种想法导致Self-doubt与Self-denial。
basic_info.core_demands: 这些Self-doubt的感受正在影响我对烹饪的信心与热情，并且影响我的日常生活，因此我决定寻求咨询。
growth_experiences: 几年前在一次做菜后Receiving negative feedback，最初引发中等强度的压力体验；此后对烹饪的信心显著下降，开始频繁Self-doubt并避免Cooking for others。虽然在负面反馈之前曾多次对自己的作品感到满意和自信，但这些正面经验在负评后被“掩盖”，被来访者视为“not算数”，逐步形成“我永远not会成为伟大Chef”的信念并影响Family relationships、日常情绪与动机。

special_situations.event: Receiving negative feedback on a dish a few years ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的菜被负面评价，就证明I am not good enough，也永远without法成为大厨
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 避免Cooking for others、反复Self-doubt、通过观看教程和练习新菜谱试图弥补但仍not敢展示
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我做得很差，I will not succeed

special_situations.event: Whenever needing to cook for others
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果做给do not人吃，not够完美就意味着失败并会让他们失望
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避Cooking for others，以减少被评价的机会
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们可能not喜欢我的菜，I will disappoint them

special_situations.event: When thinking about pursuing a cooking career or entering a professional kitchen
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果达not到专业厨房的高标准，就说明我not适合这条路
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Gives up career direction, reduces attempts, and avoids discussing with friends to avoid exposing vulnerability
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我在职业厨房一定not行，这个梦想正在滑走

special_situations.event: 当妻子和Female儿表达喜欢他的烹饪时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 正面反馈并not代表真实水平，过去的好表现not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate正面体验，not与亲友分享真实感受

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and liked through cooking, and to be seen as a capable person in family and profession
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被批评与negate、害怕让家人失望、害怕在职业厨房中失败
defense_goal: 通过回避他人评价（notCooking for others）来维持安全感
negate积极反馈以避免提升期待后的可能失败

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的家庭提供者/家庭Chef，容易One who disappoints the family
object_relations.object_representation: Family members I have let down or who may be disappointed in me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师邀请他检视并挑战“我not会成为伟大Chef”的信念、或建议进行行为实验时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者倾向认为改变not会发生，尝试是徒劳（移情性地将失败Anticipation带入当前关系）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use犹豫与怀疑的语气，强调“也许”“not过”“我觉得not用”，以此弱化尝试的必要性。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether willing to share real feelings and worries with family or friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing others will not understand or will judge oneself（把自身的羞耻与担心归于他人）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 回避直接回答，use“他们not会理解”“说出来not意义”等语句，转而结束话题。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When hearing others affirm their cooking or being reminded that the family likes their dishes
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将正面信息视为without效或not算数
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以轻描淡写或negate语句回应，如“那not一样”“那些not算”，语气冷淡，迅速换话题。

manifestations: 热爱的烹饪被Self-doubt吞噬，难以从中获得以往的意义感
想到职业厨房时感到“梦想正在滑走”与without望
拥有朋友但have not讨论Self-doubt的感受，选择独自承受
避免Cooking for others导致与家人互动减少、Relationship tension
outcomes: 亲密Relationship estrangement and tension加剧

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: RepressionCooking for others的冲动，转而自我苛责与Self-doubt
not向朋友求助或分享感受，选择独自承受

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 认为朋友not会理解自己的Self-doubt，从而not分享
预设他人会not喜欢自己的菜

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 频繁Self-denial如“I am not good enough”
Excessively cautious about trying change and accepting feedback; lacks confidence

positive_force: Loves cooking itself; has a foundation of sustained interest
The family likes his cooking, providing the possibility of positive feedback and support
Willing to try starting from familiar dishes and accepts an exploratory attitude of behavioral experiments
Has practice and self-study behaviors (watching tutorials, practicing new recipes)
拥有可用的朋友支持网络（虽not yetuse）
negative_force: Overgeneralization and negative prediction, focusing on negative feedback
negate积极反馈，难以整合正面经验
回避Cooking for others以逃避评价与失败感
Embarrassment and shame block seeking support from others

antecedent: When thinking about cooking for others
Imagines others' evaluations or recalls negative feedback from years ago
target_behavior.core_reason: 负面反馈后形成“I am not good enough/永远not会成为大厨”的信念，并对被评价产生强烈担忧（过度概括与负向Anticipation）
target_behavior.function: 逃避被评价、羞耻与潜在失败，短期缓解Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 家庭角色受影响、Strained relationships with family members、烹饪实践减少导致skill与信心进一步下降

target_behavior.behavior: 持续性的Self-doubt与Self-deprecation的自动化思维
antecedent: Scenes before/after cooking or cooking for others
思考Career development与进入专业厨房时
target_behavior.core_reason: 将单次负面反馈视为稳定特质证据，过滤与negate正向体验，维持“I am not good enough”的核心信念
target_behavior.function: 通过降低期待与Self-denial来避免进一步尝试和可能失败的风险
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood、Decreased motivation、Career pursuits stalled与日常生活受损
